qualifications: Shared edit-free getters, live local previews and canonical commands reuse the existing geometry constructors
Numeric radius locks followed by direction picks, radius/diameter input, fractional turns, pitch, twist and bare Mode toggles
Separate successful Helix/Spiral preferences outside undo history; a new axis length retains the chosen Turns/Pitch mode
Vertical axes with numeric height locks and side picks, tilted CPlanes, Flat spirals and projected radius points
Full cubic control layouts, weights, knots, domains, selection, lengths and actual undo/redo for all 25 command workflows
SDK density transitions at 10, 50 and 1000 turns, fractional span rounding and a three-span minimum; swept spiral density remains unchanged
Invalid point/number retries, unit/fraction getters, command interruption, captured-plane preview/commit consistency and local hovered direction on Enter
metric_policy: The command corpus passes full geometry/history comparisons at 1e-6. The separate 45-case SDK sampling corpus verifies all layouts but retains the analytic-tangent C2 endpoint rule. Four listed cases exceed 1e-6 in control distance; all 45 are bounded by 3e-5. They are diagnostics, not 1e-6 qualifications. The 32 additional layout probes measure counts/degree only and make no shape or performance claim.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: Four original Helix SDK inputs, retained in spiral_sampling
23 SDK turn/radius/height and variable-radius inputs, retained in spiral_sampling
Ten SDK turn-count controls, retained in spiral_sampling
First valid, deterministic point-only default Helix row retained in spiral_defaults; other exploratory rows were not qualified
22 complete managed typed getter workflows; the remembered-end row was subsequently replaced by an identical-input capture with a managed setup receipt
Two new retained-mode/new-axis-length workflows and a managed setup/end-radius recapture shared with the primary profile
Five original Spiral SDK inputs and three fractional/large-turn controls, retained in spiral_sampling
32 bounded public SDK layout measurements through 1000 turns

unqualified: Interactive rail picking and Helix AroundCurve; scripted Spiral AroundCurve remains available
Full physical mouse, viewport and snap parity; native typed recipes are not mouse receipts
Deterministic native numeric/Enter start directions without pointer acknowledgement
Native preference retention on cancellation; local preferences are committed on successful completion
Full 1e-6 endpoint-control agreement in the four named diagnostic cases
Exhaustive extreme parameters, density boundaries beyond the measured range and performance parity
